items.text: Welcome to the Time Lab archive. Click the three dots on the left to review the past.
For past actions we often use the simple past.
I visited my grandparents during the winter holiday.
I learned to swim last summer.
I joined the school English club last term.
I am going to study English harder.
I am going to travel with my family.
I am going to learn to play the piano.
I am going to play basketball every week.
I am going to visit my grandparents this weekend.
We are going to play basketball tomorrow.
I am not going to watch TV tonight.
She isn't going to call him back.
Are you going to finish your homework?
Is he going to join the club?
What are you going to do after school?
Where are they going to meet?
I am going to be busy next week.
She is going to be ready at eight.
I am not going to be late again.
They aren't going to be here until Friday.
Are you going to be free this evening?
Is it going to be cold tomorrow?
How are you going to be sure?
Where is she going to be next year?
